description: Takes the name off a thread: nobody is handling it, and it goes back to the queue for whoever picks it up. It closes no door, the thread having been readable by everybody working that queue the whole time. Replayed on a thread nobody had taken, it answers the same thing. To give several threads back to the queue, give conversation_id the list of their ids, in ONE call rather than one call per thread: the answer then lists in "results" the outcome of each thread in the order given ("ok", with its "result" or its "error") and counts "succeeded" and "failed". Each thread passes exactly the checks it would alone, so one refused or out of reach ("not found") leaves the others done, and the call is an error only when none succeeded.

conversation_id.description: The id of the conversation, as list_conversations gives it, or a list of up to 50 ids to do the same to every one of them in a single call.

name: unassign_conversation
title: Give a thread back to the queue
